deviations.reason: Independent review reproduced the historical strict Composer failure because Access, Audit and Licensing were stored in packages-dev. The lock was regenerated after declaring the existing UI and Dataview path graph and aligning the package minimum-stability with the Larena development graph; strict validation and the full package gate now pass.
Administrator invitation delivery runs after its Auth-owned commit and must not be presented as exactly-once delivery through a generic Core transaction.

The existing asset publisher fixture inherited Git's linked-worktree GIT_INDEX_FILE inside commit hooks and wrote disposable fixture entries into the package index. The standalone test now clears repository-local Git environment variables before creating its temporary repository.
